# infrawrench_bastion (Resource)

An enrollment for a bastion agent — the container you run inside a private network so Infrawrench can reach cloud APIs and hosts that are not exposed to the internet.

Creating one mints an enrollment token; running the agent with it is a separate step this resource does not perform. Bind an account to the bastion with `bastion_id` on `infrawrench_account`.

There is no update route, so renaming replaces — which re-enrolls, meaning a **new token and an agent that must be restarted with it**. Bear that in mind before editing `name`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name — usually where the agent runs, e.g. `prod-vpc-eu-west-1`.

### Read-Only

- `connected` (Boolean) Whether an agent is talking to the server right now. Live state — it changes without the configuration changing.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned bastion id. `terraform import` works, but see `token`.
- `status` (String) Enrollment status as the server reports it.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Enrollment token in the form `iwb_…`, passed to the agent container as `BASTION_TOKEN`. Returned **once**, at creation.

Null on an imported or refreshed resource — nothing can recover it. Same state-file warning as `infrawrench_api_key`.
- `token_prefix` (String) Non-secret leading segment of the enrollment token, shown in the UI.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the URL when you open the object in the app, and in the
# --json output of the Infrawrench CLI.
terraform import infrawrench_bastion.example 8c9d0e1f-2a3b-4c5d-6e7f-8a9b0c1d2e3f
```
